name: p6-extend-swap
notes: P6 (corrupt-events): a queued EXTEND executes along the swapped-in facing. Script window 0 places a torch west of piston A (facing up): checkIfExtend queues an extend during packet handling. The chord in the same window breaks A and places a piston facing east (still powered by the west torch: signal from the west counts for an east-facing piston). The event pushes the stone at (1,2,0) east. Baseline (no chord): A extends up, the stone stays. Scan window 0 only.
